title: Paper 1 R2 — Venuto-2025 deep exploration
purpose: Two follow-on Venuto analyses: (1) PPMI-tuned re-fit to verify construct-validity defense robustness; (2) Q.E.D. OPTION 1 stratified anchor analysis on the Venuto-imputed full cohort.

stratum_counts_compared_to_observed_only.observed_only: 138 patients with both SAA tested and UPSIT (q_gap_a_venuto_saa)

stratified_anchor_analysis.interpretation: By using Venuto-imputed S anchors for the SAA-untested patients with UPSIT data, we expand the dual-anchor-classified cohort from 138 (observed SAA only) to the count above. Per-stratum NSD+ AUC could be evaluated next; a comparable AUC across S+D+ vs S−D+ strata would confirm the model is not dependent on a particular anchor configuration. Discordant strata (S+D−, S−D+) directly probe construct validity for non-canonical phenotypes.
